initialize_urdf_editor: create a UrdfEditor instance to programmatically build and manage URDF robot descriptions in PyBullet
initialize_from_bullet_body: extract URDF link and joint data from an existing PyBullet multi-body using initializeFromBulletBody
save_urdf_to_file: save the current URDF editor state to a .urdf XML file using saveUrdf with optional visuals
join_two_urdf_robots: merge two UrdfEditor instances into one robot by calling joinUrdf with pivot transforms
create_multibody_from_urdf: create a PyBullet multi-body object from the URDF editor data using createMultiBody
